name: yn-tools
description: YN Claude Code toolkit. Plugins are grouped by role: yn-core, yn-dev, yn-qc, yn-pm, yn-design, yn-ops.

plugins.name: yn-core
plugins.description: Cross-role foundations. queue-*: a local, file-based task queue that triages tasks into groups and implements them (in-session, in parallel worktrees, or headless).

plugins.name: yn-qc
plugins.description: QC toolkit. requirement-review, release-review (go/no-go), checklist-gen/import (Excel checklist + RTM + open questions), ticket-review (Jira), retest-run (UI-only Playwright), testrun-report.
